$Comment: What Lanterns in the Temple pays when the player finds Old Jack: a small welcome of sweets,
through the Currency reward kind, since a counter wallet has no item to hand over. The quest
pays this table through its Claim bucket: the sweets wait in the quest until the player collects
them, and collecting them at Old Jack leads straight on to Pumpkin Patch's offer. A companion mod
adds its own rolls to this table with a file of its own that names it in ContributesTo, so
Name: Hallows_Eve_Meet_Pay
